tools.name: browse-categories
tools.description: Navigate to a specific content category or view all categories. Categories organize articles by topic.

category.description: Category slug (e.g., "artificial-intelligence", "machine-learning"). Leave empty to view all categories.

tools.name: discover-content
tools.description: Access XML sitemaps for systematic content discovery. Returns structured navigation to all published content.

type.description: Type of sitemap: "all" for main index, "categories" for category-based, "articles" for article listings

tools.name: get-latest-articles
tools.description: Fetch the latest published articles from Toxigon. Returns RSS feed with recent content.

tools.name: search-articles
tools.description: Search Toxigon's AI-focused content library by keyword. Returns relevant articles matching the search query.

query.description: The search query term or phrase
